summary: Iter31 tested Excel export of the history, global chrome (bottom nav + top search), Scan (product code + pickup code), and the editor barcode field. Backend: 26/27 new tests pass. Passing: history date filters (WIB inclusive, 400 for bad dates and for from>to), export xlsx (sheets Riwayat & Ringkasan, Sebelum/Sesudah/Selisih with Selisih = after-before, counts match the list, admin can see all stores or one store_id, jombang sees only its own store, jombang with store_id=pgs-official gets 403, customer gets 403), by-code lookup by SKU (case-insensitive, trimmed), product_id and barcode, unknown code gives 404, pickup lookup/complete (store admin, Super Admin, other branch 404, customer 403, completed 400). Failing: by-code with a scanned URL gives 404, because the encoded '/' in the path breaks route matching. Regression iter29 + iter16: all pass. Frontend: bottom nav shows on every page except login/register/checkout/forgot-password. Top search shows everywhere except home/search/scan, and tapping it opens /search. Nav works from nested pages, the active tab is highlighted, and the cart badge shows 2. Scan: customer sees no mode switch, store admin/seller see it, the permission card shows on web, manual SKU DBLP32HC opens /product/pgs-9849, and an unknown code shows an error. Pickup: other branch gets an error, PGS Sidoarjo sees the result, due amount and complete button, confirm completes the order, and a re-lookup shows Selesai with no button. History: Periode pills and date inputs filter correctly, Unduh Excel downloads, and the from>to error shows. Editor: pe-barcode strips spaces and saves, and scanning the saved barcode opens the product. No deprecated expo packages found; expo-camera is used.

critical.issue: Scanning a QR that holds a product link fails. scan.tsx sends encodeURIComponent('https://x.id/product/pgs-9849'), so the path contains %2F. Starlette decodes the path before routing, '{code}' cannot match a path with '/', and the request returns a generic 404 {'detail':'Not Found'}. The /product/<id> regex in the handler never runs. Fix: '@api.get("/products/by-code/{code:path}")' (server.py:707), or send the code as a query param (?code=).

minor.issue: _pickup_order (seller.py:460) takes the newest order with that 6-digit pickup_code. Super Admin searches all stores, so codes from different stores can collide. Inside one store, an older active order is unreachable if a newer order (even completed) has the same code. Prefer active statuses first, or make pickup_code unique per store among open orders.
A branch admin with zero rows gets filename 'riwayat-harga-stok-semua-toko-...' (history.py:136 falls back when docs is empty). Use the resolved query['store_id'] instead.
No uniqueness check on barcode. Two products with the same barcode silently resolve to whichever is found first.

ui_bugs.issue: After handover, and on re-lookup of a completed COD order, the card still shows red 'Tagih tunai: Rp213.000'. The cashier may think cash is still due. When done or status is completed, show 'Sudah dibayar & diambil' instead. Reference: app/scan.tsx:37,49

At 390px the date inputs overflow the period card: ph-date-to spans x 237..438 while the card ends at 374, so its right border is clipped. The input row needs flexWrap or minWidth 0 on the inputs. Reference: app/product-editor/history.tsx:135-139,176

With from>to, ph-error shows but the previous items stay listed. The old 'File Excel riwayat berhasil dibuat' message also stays after the filters change. The ph-export button stays enabled when from>to (the backend returns 400 and an error message appears).

integration_issues.issue: Fails with 'Not Found' because of the backend route issue above.

issues: The sticky editor footer (about 184px) plus the global bottom nav (about 62px) take about 30% of the screen. The 'Simpan Draft' label wraps onto 2 lines. Consider hiding the global nav on /product-editor/[id] or compacting the footer.
Shows two search entry points: the global top search bar and its own header search icon. The header icon is redundant now.
keyboardType number-pad blocks the letters used in code128/code39 barcodes on native. Use the default keyboard or allow alphanumerics.

action_items: HIGH: server.py:707 change the route to '/products/by-code/{code:path}' (or use a query param) so scanned product URLs resolve. test_url in test_pgs_iter31_scan_export.py covers it.
Scan PickupResult: don't show 'Tagih tunai' in red once the order is completed (done or status=completed).
History page: fix the date input row overflow on mobile, clear stale items/export message on error, and disable export when from>to.
Optional: pickup code collision handling (prefer open orders), export filename for empty branch export, barcode uniqueness, pe-barcode keyboard, editor footer vs global nav space.
critical_code_review_comments: app-chrome.tsx: clean approach. It overrides SafeAreaInsetsContext so screens don't double-pad, and hides the nav when the native keyboard is open. The PLAIN list also hides chrome on /forgot-password (beyond the request, acceptable).
scan.tsx: after router.push to a product, lock is released after 1.5s. If the camera is still mounted when the user comes back, the same barcode may push again. Consider resetting on focus.
history export loads up to 50000 docs into memory and builds openpyxl in a threadpool. Fine for monthly reports.
server.py is 1310 lines (>700). Should be split further.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work; 2 medium UI bugs + 1 integration failure for URL QR)

seed_data_creation: Temporary only: TEST pickup COD orders (demo@pgs.id at pgs-official, product pgs-9955) were deleted afterwards and pgs-9955 stock/sold restored. TEST_Scan products (acct1) were deleted with their drafts and price_history. The demo cart item added for the badge test was removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env; pytest -n0 tests/test_pgs_iter31_scan_export.py. UI pickup test: python tests/ui_iter31_helper.py create (prints order_id + pickup code), then clean. In Playwright, wait about 2.5s after the first load before setting localStorage 'pgs_auth_token', otherwise the app may ignore it. Editor publish opens a confirm dialog (confirm-ok). Get tokens with page.request.post, because urllib is blocked by 403.
rca_of_issue: by-code URL: Starlette's router matches against the decoded path, so '%2F' becomes '/' and the '{code}' segment converter (which excludes '/') fails. Repro: curl $BASE/api/products/by-code/https%3A%2F%2Fx.id%2Fproduct%2Fpgs-9849 returns 404 {'detail':'Not Found'}. Fix: use the ':path' converter.
